name: fadblock
description: FAdblock — Chrome ve Firefox ucun ad blocker extension

scripts.generate: npm run generate:rules && npm run generate:icons
scripts.pack:chrome: mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/fadblock-chrome.zip manifest.json background content popup options rules icons -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.pack:firefox: mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/fadblock-firefox.zip manifest.json background content popup options rules icons -x '*.DS_Store'
